implementation_notes: Packages in the workspace, one `index.ts` barrel per module, and `import type` for type-only edges so the runtime dependency graph stays smaller than the type graph. Enable project references so boundaries are enforced at build time.
idiom_name: workspace package + barrel + import type for type-only edges
pitfalls: Type-only imports written without `type`, creating runtime cycles
Barrels that re-export everything, making the boundary meaningless
